generation_summary.notes: Simple atomic control of voice texture using tags. Instructions are in English and must cue the Portuguese language. The text to be spoken is in Portuguese.

text_constraints: Must be in Portuguese.
Lexical content must not leak the target texture.
final text must be written in Portuguese
instruction_constraints: Must be in English.
Must include a language cue like 'Speak in Portuguese.'
final instruction must be in English and should begin with 'Speak in Portuguese.'
use fixed tag format 'Attribute: Value' in final realization
